bagPolicy.summary: The stadium event guidance permits clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches; diaper bags may be permitted with a child. Medical items outside these dimensions are screened at the Public Safety Building between Gates A and B.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Rose Bowl event guide describes stadium parking areas and an express shuttle from the Parsons Engineering Complex in Old Pasadena to Lot B/Gate B. Parking prices and opening times depend on the event.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The stadium event page directs rideshare and taxi pickups and drop-offs to the Old Town area of Pasadena; confirm this with the concert’s event page.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The official stadium event page lists prohibited outside alcoholic beverages, cans, glass bottles and coolers, but does not give a general concert concessions menu.

accessibility.summary: Medically necessary items that do not fit the bag policy are screened at the Public Safety Building between Gates A and B. The cited event page does not state broader concert accessibility arrangements.
